title: Adenanthin exhibits anti-inflammatory effects by covalently targeting the p65 subunit in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Tong, Lu; Zha, Meng-Li; Hu, Junchi; Li, Hai-Yang; Kuai, Le; Li, Bin; Dang, Yongjun; Zhao, Qunfei; Liao, Rijing; Lin, Guo-Qiang; He, Qing-Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物腺花素共价修饰NF-κB p65亚基Cys38以抑制其DNA结合，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA特异性建模，且方法以实验为主、仅含分子对接，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Adenanthin is a structurally unique ent-kaurane diterpenoid isolated from Rabdosia adenantha, a traditional Chinese medicinal plant with potent anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory activities. However, its anti-inflammatory molecular mechanism remains largely elusive to date. Here, we developed an affinity-based label-free protein profiling (ALFPP) to identify potential covalent targets of electrophilic natural products with ketone or aldehyde groups. Using ALFPP, we identified 27 potential covalent targets of adenanthin, among which p65 (RelA) has been associated with its anti-inflammatory activities. Through a series of experiments, including LC-MS/MS, molecular docking, electrophoretic mobility shift assays (EMSA), and genome editing, we demonstrated that adenanthin could covalently modify the Cys38 residue of p65 to affect the binding of DNA to p65, thereby inhibiting the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. ALFPP will facilitate the target identification of electrophilic carbonylated natural products, especially those containing alpha, beta-unsaturated keto groups. Furthermore, the elucidation of the molecular mechanism of adenanthin will contribute to new drug development of adenanthin to treat inflammations and cancers, enhancing the possibility for its clinical application.
abstract_zh: Adenanthin是一种结构独特的ent-kaurane型二萜类化合物，分离自传统中草药 Rabdosia adenantha，具有显著的抗癌和抗炎活性。然而，其抗炎的分子机制至今仍 largely elusive。在此，我们开发了一种基于亲和力的无标记蛋白质谱分析（ALFPP）方法，用于识别含有酮或醛基团的亲电天然产物的潜在共价靶点。利用ALFPP，我们鉴定了adenanthin的27个潜在共价靶点，其中p65（RelA）与其抗炎活性相关。通过一系列实验，包括LC-MS/MS、分子对接、电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）和基因组编辑，我们证明adenanthin能够共价修饰p65的Cys38残基，影响DNA与p65的结合，从而抑制NF-kappaB信号通路。ALFPP将有助于识别亲电羰基化天然产物的靶点，尤其是那些含有α,β-不饱和酮基团的化合物。此外，adenanthin分子机制的阐明将有助于adenanthin治疗炎症和癌症的新药开发，提高其临床应用的可能性。
